desc: Build max-Cartesian tree with monotonic stack and compute subtree sums S[u].
Compute g[u] (start can absorb at least one strictly smaller neighbour) and top[u] via pre-order with crossing condition S[c] > A[parent].
Answer = S[top[u]] if g[u] else A[u]; iterative O(N) solution using sys.stdin.buffer.
Verified against both public samples and tie-heavy cases; sample tests PASSED.
